build_RegNet_backbone: build a RegNet backbone model with configurable depth, width slope, width base, and width multiplier parameters
build_AnyNet_backbone: build an AnyNet backbone with custom stem, block class, stage depths, widths, strides, and normalization
create_ResBottleneckBlock: create a ResBottleneckBlock residual bottleneck block with 1x1, 3x3 grouped conv, optional SE, and 1x1 projection
generate_regnet_parameters: generate per-stage widths and depths from RegNet quantization parameters w_a, w_0, w_m, and total depth
create_ResStem: create a ResStem module with 7x7 conv, batch norm, activation, and 3x3 max pooling for ImageNet input
